answer: An agent economy curbs Sybil attacks by tying node identities to microbial electrochemical impedance in a sensor garden. Agents report metabolic electron flux stimulated by a pulsed light lantern, verifying integrity through a shared hardware haven. Forging identities forces adversaries to acquire and maintain physical bio-reactors, as living soil chemistry cannot be emulated digitally. However, sudden moisture loss degrades biofilm conductivity, causing false identity rejections.
